label: From Cartesian to vector form
subgoals: Plot y = mx + q point by point from a table
Redraw the line through P0 along v
Sweep t over R to trace the full line

label: Parametric form
subgoals: Step t through values to plot (x0+kt, y0+ht)
Read the step direction (k, h) off the plotted dots
Join the plotted dots into the line

label: Example
subgoals: Mark P0 = (2,1) and P = (5,4) on the plane
Join the dots into the line through (2,1) and (5,4)
